title: A normalized frame cover for prescribed component sections
statement: Let $Y$ be a reduced scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-reduced-scheme], and let $i_a:Z_a\to Y$ be a finite family of closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose images cover $Y$. Suppose intersections of distinct images are discrete. Let $M_a$ be invertible modules [def-sc-invertible-module] and let $s_a\in\Gamma(Z_a,M_a)$ be nonvanishing [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] at all intersections involving $a$. There are an open cover $(U_b)$ of $Y$, functions $f_b\in\Gamma(Y,U_b)$, and free generators [def-sc-local-free-generator] $m_{ab}$ of $M_a$ on $i_a^{-1}U_b$ such that $s_a=i_a^\sharp(f_b)m_{ab}$ on $i_a^{-1}U_b$. For every distinct pair $b\ne c$ and every open $W\subset U_b\cap U_c$, the map $\Gamma(Y,W)\to\prod_a\Gamma(Z_a,i_a^{-1}W)$ induced by the closed immersions is bijective. The cover index is a type in universe $\max(u,v)$. No transitions, cocycle, glued module, or global section are asserted.

proof.text: Let T be the finite union of pairwise intersections. Use glue_component_reduced_cover_sections to obtain the open, pairwise disjoint component pieces off T and the structure-section product bijection. Closed immersion images are closed. Apply Mathlib IsDiscrete.iUnion three times to the finite closed discrete pairwise intersections, obtaining that T is discrete.

proof.text: For t in T, isolate t by an ambient open V using Mathlib isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen. On every component incident to t, the prescribed section generates at its unique preimage, by the nonvanishing/local-generation equivalence. Set B_a to the closed image of the complement of the generating locus of s_a, and take U_t = V intersect the complement of the finite union of B_a. This open contains t, meets T only at t, and each component preimage lies in its generating locus. Restrict the free generator s_a on its generating locus to obtain all normalized frames, including the empty component preimages.

proof.text: For each x off T, choose a component a and its unique preimage z. The component piece D_a = T-complement intersect image(i_a) is open. Choose a free-generator neighborhood W of z contained in the preimage of D_a. The ambient open U_x = D_a intersect the complement of image(i_a)(W-complement) contains x and has component-a preimage contained in W. Restrict its frame. Every other component preimage is empty by pairwise disjointness; use its zero section, proved to be a free generator by sheaf separatedness on the empty open. Use the coefficients of the prescribed sections in these frames and the reduced-cover surjection to obtain f_x. On U_t use f_t = 1. Index both families by ULift(T) plus ULift(T-complement), a type in max(u,v), and prove they cover by membership cases. Distinct point neighborhoods overlap off T because each meets T only at its distinguished point. All other members avoid T. Therefore any open in a distinct overlap avoids T, and the reduced-cover section bijection proves the final clause. The same construction handles empty T, empty Y and an empty component index.

theorem exists_normalized_component_section_cover
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] {ι : Type v} [Finite ι]
    (Z : ι → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ a : ι, Z a ⟶ Y) [∀ a : ι, IsClosedImmersion (i a)]
    (hcover : (⋃ a : ι, Set.range (i a)) = Set.univ)
    (hdiscrete : ∀ a b : ι, a ≠ b →
      DiscreteTopology ↥(Set.range (i a) ∩ Set.range (i b)))
    (M : ∀ a : ι, (Z a).Modules) [∀ a : ι, (M a).IsInvertible]
    (s : ∀ a : ι, Γ(M a, ⊤))
    (hs : ∀ a b : ι, a ≠ b → Set.range (i a) ∩ Set.range (i b) ⊆
      i a '' nonvanishingLocus (M a) (s a)) :
    ∃ (κ : Type (max u v)) (U : κ → Y.Opens) (f : ∀ b, Γ(Y, U b))
      (m : ∀ a b, Γ(M a, (i a) ⁻¹ᵁ U b)),
      (⨆ b, U b) = ⊤ ∧
      (∀ a b, IsFreeGenerator (m a b)) ∧
      (∀ a b, (M a).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (s a) =
        ((i a).app (U b)).hom (f b) • m a b) ∧
      ∀ b c, b ≠ c → ∀ (W : Y.Opens), W ≤ U b → W ≤ U c →
        Function.Bijective
          (fun r : Γ(Y, W) ↦ fun a ↦ ((i a).app W).hom r)
